question: How many different customers have at least one completed order in the Partner channel?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM orders WHERE channel='Partner' AND status='completed'

question: How many customers does each region have?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers c JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id GROUP BY r.name

question: Which product has the highest list price, and what is that price?
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

question: What is the cheapest list price in each product category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, MIN(unit_price) AS cheapest_price FROM products GROUP BY category

question: Which region had the most returned orders, and how many were there?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE o.status='returned' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY returned_orders DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units of each Software product were sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND p.category='Software' GROUP BY p.name

question: How much revenue did Enterprise customers generate through each sales channel?
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.segment='Enterprise' GROUP BY o.channel

question: How many completed orders were there in each quarter of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(substr(order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) <= 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN CAST(substr(order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN CAST(substr(order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) <= 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

question: Which 3 products sold the most units? Show the product names and units sold.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 3

question: On average, how many units are in a completed order?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0*SUM(oi.quantity)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS avg_units_per_order FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed'

question: What was the revenue for each product category in December 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category

question: What percentage of orders were cancelled in each channel?
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS cancelled_pct FROM orders GROUP BY channel

question: Which single product category lost the most revenue between Q2 and Q3 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) ASC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average order value of Online orders compared with Retail orders?
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount))/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.channel IN ('Online','Retail') GROUP BY o.channel

question: How much Electronics revenue did each region make in Q4 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND p.category='Electronics' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY r.name

question: Which month of 2025 had the highest revenue, and how much was it?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have never returned an order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status='returned')

question: What percentage of total revenue came from each customer segment?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(100.0*SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount))/(SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity*oi2.unit_price*(1-oi2.discount)) FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.order_id=o2.order_id WHERE o2.status='completed'),2) AS revenue_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.segment

question: What is the average line-item discount, as a percentage, on completed orders in each channel?
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(100.0*AVG(oi.discount),2) AS avg_discount_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.channel
